logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the complexes was determined using the "shake-flask" method in octanol-water phase partitioning.1,2 The complexes were dissolved in a mixture of water and n-octanol and shaken for 24 hours. After settling for 30 minutes, the two phases were collected separately to prevent cross-contamination. The concentration of the complexes in each phase was measured by UV-Vis absorption spectroscopy at room temperature. The results represent the mean values from three independent experiments. The concentration of the sample solution was used to calculate the log P values. The partition coefficients for the four complexes were calculated with the formula: log P = log[octanol]/[water].
